rca of the issue: Original RCA (from main agent, confirmed by this retest): the pre-redeploy production backend's TeamInput Pydantic model did not include the startingHoleLabel field, so when the labels were first written via the API, they were silently stripped at write-time. Fix: main agent redeployed the label-aware backend and re-applied martin=1A, white=1B via /api/admin. This retest confirms both the API payload and the rendered UI now expose 1A/1B correctly.
